title: A product sketch becomes an ad
pitch: A pencil sketch of a lamp in. A photo that follows the sketch's lines, the lamp switching on, and a score out.
why: The sketch is the brief. Klein draws it, Z-Image's union ControlNet follows its lines into a photo, Wan 2.2 turns the lamp on, and Music 3 scores the moment.

models.name: MiniMax Music 3
models.note: Commercial use must show the name MiniMax-Music3.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Clean dark lines on white paper are easiest for the ControlNet to follow.

steps.label: The sketch
steps.prompt: A clean pencil line drawing of a modern adjustable desk lamp with a round shade and a weighted base, side view, dark lines on plain white paper, no shading, no text.

steps.label: Photo from the sketch

70:45.text: Studio product photograph of a modern brushed brass desk lamp with a round shade and a heavy round base on a dark walnut desk, dark background, soft rim light. No text.

steps.does: A photo that keeps the sketch's lines.

steps.label: Switching on
steps.prompt: The lamp switches on and warm light spreads slowly across the walnut desk. The camera slowly pushes in.
